data.title: SASO Stresses Importance of Verifying Compliance of Imported Vehicles Bearing GCC License Plates Through Saber Platform
data.content: Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi Standards, Metrology and Quality Organization (SASO) stressed the importance of verifying that vehicles bearing Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) license plates and located in Saudi Arabia comply with Saudi standards and technical regulations. SASO indicated that compliance can be verified through the vehicle import service available on the Saber platform, which enables beneficiaries to complete the requirements for obtaining a Vehicle Import Shipment Certificate. The service is intended for citizens and residents who own vehicles bearing GCC license plates, registered in one of the GCC member states and used in Saudi Arabia. It enables them to verify that their vehicles comply with approved technical regulations and standards, supporting the procedures for importing and registering their vehicles. Over the past two years, more than 6,000 Vehicle Import Shipment Certificates have been issued through the Saber platform, reflecting the extent to which the service has been used. SASO urged owners of vehicles registered in GCC member states and located in Saudi Arabia who wish to use the service to review the requirements and complete the procedures for obtaining a Vehicle Import Shipment Certificate through the Saber electronic platform at: ‏https://saber.sa/ . -- SPA 17:22 Local Time 14:22 GMT 0047
